# gravitino_schemas Data Source

Lists all schemas within a Gravitino metalake and catalog.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "gravitino_schemas" "example" {
  # ... example configuration ...
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The catalog name.
- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.

### Read-Only

- `schemas` (Attributes List) List of schemas with their details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schemas))

<a id="nestedatt--schemas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schemas`

Read-Only:

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the schema. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schemas--audit))
- `comment` (String) The schema comment.
- `name` (String) The schema name.
- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value properties for the schema.

<a id="nestedatt--schemas--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schemas.audit`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `creator` (String)
- `last_modified_time` (String)
- `last_modifier` (String)
